note: Notes of the call with the CFO on 12 November

links.why: The loan pays EUR 12m of the EUR 14m that the line costs.

facts.statement: The CFO said the gross margin fell in 2025 because raw milk prices rose 18% during the drought.
Cedar buys milk from three cooperatives under contracts that fix volumes, not prices.
The CFO said Bluegate pays within 45 days.
Lakeside Distributors buys under a one-year contract, and three other distributors serve the same region.
About 6,000 smallholder farmers deliver milk through the three cooperatives. In the dry months, January to March, the plant gets about a third less milk.

answers.value: All milk comes from smallholders, at an open price, and a third less of it in the dry months. Costs and volumes move with the weather.

facts.statement: The second UHT line goes into the existing hall in Nakuru and doubles capacity to 24,000 litres an hour. The first line has run close to full since 2024.
facts.label: Capacity with the second line

facts.statement: The second line costs EUR 14m. The loan pays EUR 12m and Cedar pays the rest from its own cash. The supplier is not chosen. Start-up is planned for the third quarter of 2027.
facts.label: Cost

answers.value: A second UHT line in the existing hall in Nakuru, EUR 14m, start-up planned for the third quarter of 2027. Not yet ordered.

facts.statement: Cedar buys raw milk from three cooperatives, makes UHT milk and yoghurt from it in Nakuru and sells them in Kenya to supermarkets and distributors (F-001, F-009, F-013).

answers.value: Buys raw milk from cooperatives, processes it into UHT milk and yoghurt, sells in Kenya to supermarkets and distributors.

decisions.decision: Lakeside Distributors gets no page and no checks of its own.
decisions.reason: It buys 14% of revenue and can be replaced: three other distributors serve the same region.

decisions.decision: Cedar is to propose how it will cover the euro loan before the concept note goes in.
decisions.reason: The loan is asked in euros and all revenue is in shillings.

questions.text: Please send the supply contracts with the three cooperatives.
